dialect.detail: IBM mainframe-style COBOL, likely compiled with IBM COBOL for z/OS or compatible; uses GOBACK, BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS, and IBM-3083 as SOURCE/OBJECT-COMPUTER. File paths suggest PC/Windows environment (G:\cobol\archivos\), possibly a student exercise targeting IBM dialect.

purpose.domain_detail: Banking/HR context (Banco de los Lagos employee file processing), but structured as a student exercise at a training center (CENTRO DE CAPACITACION)
purpose.summary: Reads an employee flat file (EMPLEADO.TXT) and produces a formatted report (REPORTE.TXT) listing employee number, name, status, department, position, and salary. Prints totals for records read, records printed, and sum of salaries at the end.

notable_features: WRITE ... AFTER ADVANCING PAGE for report formatting
Hardcoded date values in LK-FECHA (commented-out LINKAGE SECTION used as working storage)
PERFORM ... THRU ... EXIT pattern for paragraph grouping
Windows file paths in SELECT ASSIGN
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric accumulation
VALUES (plural) used instead of VALUE in several FILLER clauses
verdict.notes: The LINKAGE SECTION is commented out but the 01-level LK-FECHA is declared directly in WORKING-STORAGE, which is unusual and suggests a student adaptation. The plural 'VALUES' keyword used in several FILLER clauses is non-standard but accepted by some compilers. The program is dated 02/08/18 and attributed to author CABARZA at Banco de los Lagos, consistent with a training exercise.
